title.en: An Act Authorizing the Amount of Nine thousand Pesos to Be Loaned to the Municipality of Tayasan, Province of Oriental Negros, to Be Used for the Construction of Waterworks and of a Market Building Instead of for the Construction of a School Building.

text.en:
The last paragraph under Oriental Negros of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred
andtwenty is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Municipality of Tayasan for the construction of water works and a market building, payable in ten annual
amortized installments nine thousand pesos."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved. October 29, 1929.
